about: The promotion gate's rules (chapter 23), as data. python -m helpdesk.gate check tests them on every change: with this many trials, a regression case must be able to fail the gate, and one still passing at the expected rate must rarely fail it by chance. expected_pass_rate and false_alarm are the lab's choices; change them here, never in the code. every_trial names suites where one failed trial fails the gate. A suite fails the gate when the cases that passed every trial at promotion fail, added up, at least the fewest trials that cases still passing at the expected rate would fail by chance no more often than false_alarm; suite_min_cases is the fewest such cases that rule is used on, and check prints each suite's threshold and how often a healthy suite fails. require_real true means only a run on a real model may promote, and check fails a record measured on the mock; a team sets it true once its promotions come from real runs.
